transcripts.text: There is no secret trick. You just have to feel the discomfort and still move forward. There is no certainty built into life, there is no warm, cozy safety blanket that we can cling to, because that does not come equipped with the features of reality. What you're truly looking for is a tolerance to the unknown. And by sitting with the discomfort of not knowing what the future holds, you'll see that over time your mind stops to grasp at straws trying to predict what will happen, because you'll never know what's going to happen. All you can do is cut off the addiction of seeking for reassurance. Every time you want that reassurance that the future is not going to hurt you, or that there won't be any discomfort moving forward, you have to stop yourself in your tracks and realize that by feeling this discomfort of not knowing, I actually free myself from the constant thought loops and overthinking of worry and anxiety. By not trying to predict the future, I allow myself to enjoy the present. You don't have to disprove the worries that your mind creates. You just have to sit with the discomfort in your body when you realize you do not know what the future holds.
